results.title: The Interview
results.overview: Four strangers on their way to a job interview get stuck in a lift. They share their trauma, only to discover that the interview has already begun.

results.title: Cocoons
results.overview: In a Rayalaseema village, three carefree friends who dream big but dodge responsibility spot a chance to make easy money during the local elections. Their scheme ends up deceiving the voters and their own families, until the consequences catch up with them.

results.title: The Reagan Incident

results.title: Fists and Chips
results.overview: Holly and Three Bellies battle over a bag of chips to discover nothing is worth more than being alive.

results.title: 3650 Days
results.overview: When Madeline and Damien's eyes meet on a night out, their paths rapidly intertwine in a whirlwind of passion. Time stops as their realities intersect. Frozen in time, their futures meld as they dance with the chance encounter. Can two strangers find eternity in a night?

results.title: Hunger Pains
results.overview: In rural Appalachia, a restless young woman defies her overbearing mother for her first taste of freedom, unleashing the monstrous appetite she’s been taught to fear.

results.title: Hard, on the Outside
results.overview: Anya, Mila, Aleks, and Maksym are Russian and Ukrainian immigrants settling into their new lives. We experience their everyday struggles to acclimate to life in the West while we learn with them that "a smile goes a long way" in America.

results.title: Holy Relic
results.overview: When a troubled father discovers a malevolent presence inhabiting a religious artifact, he investigates with the help of his two young sons.

results.title: Submissive Homeland
results.overview: Brazil truly has the "secret sauce," and people from the outside are taking notice.  While Trump, in the United States, has his eyes on our mineral wealth, Flávio Bolsonaro—a candidate for the Brazilian presidency—is promising to hand over our rare earth elements in an attempt to win an election.  In this episode, we interview General Santos Cruz, a former minister under Jair Bolsonaro, who states: this is not what it means to be right-wing, nor is it patriotic—it is complete submission. Our minerals are strategic, both for us and for the world. The question that remains is: who will own this wealth in the years to come? Will you just sit by while it’s handed over to Trump on a silver platter?

results.title: Angel & Meow
results.overview: A meta-cinematic odyssey where the boundaries between a composer's studio and a sci-fi galaxy dissolve through the power of music and an unlikely friendship.

results.title: Out of Time
results.overview: Childhood friends meet up to complete an escape room for the anniversary of their friend's death.

results.title: Psycho Side Chick
results.overview: After being dumped by her married lover, a crazed woman fights to win him back and will get rid of anyone who stands in her way.

results.title: Home Video
results.overview: A 8 year old boy playing with a camcorder, while recording his house and atmosphere he accidentally records audio of his father talking on the phone, several phone conversations of the father reveal a meticulous planning of a POGROM.  On 28 February 2002, a three-day period of inter-communal (Hindus and Muslims) violence began in the western Indian state of Gujarat. This was the first pogrom where telephones and cellphones were used as a major operational tool and the riots were meticulously per-planned, thousands of people (official number : 1,044 ) mostly Muslims were killed in the three day pogrom. The riots were particularly carried out to target Muslim.

results.title: An Akoon
results.overview: “An Akoon” means “To be”. An Akoon is a poetic, experimental, and intuitive film that confronts the weight of existence, a yearning to return to a state before becoming, before the weight of consciousness. In the depths of inner turmoil, the film dives into war, grief, anger, fear, and remorse, rooted in the profound bond between mother and child.
